description: Design System foundation: enrich index.css with a complete token set (HSL-based palette, border-radius scale, shadow scale, typography scale), new CSS animations (fadeIn, slideUp already exists — add ripple, shimmer, fadeInUp), dark mode .dark class variable block, and missing CSS classes referenced by existing JSX but not yet defined (auth-intro, auth-brand, auth-card-mark, auth-status, auth-feature-list, auth-visual, auth-orbit, auth-grid-lines, auth-signal, launch-icon, launch-template, launch-voice, launch-connect, header-kicker-dot). This is independent of FEAT-002 through FEAT-004 but all other FEATs depend on these tokens being in place first.
steps: Step 1 — Open client/src/index.css. Extend the :root block with new CSS custom property tokens. Add: --radius-sm: 8px, --radius-md: 12px, --radius-lg: 16px, --radius-xl: 20px, --radius-full: 9999px. Add shadow scale: --shadow-xs: 0 1px 3px rgba(100,90,120,.07), --shadow-sm: 0 4px 12px rgba(100,90,120,.08), --shadow-md: 0 8px 25px rgba(100,90,120,.10), --shadow-lg: 0 16px 40px rgba(100,90,120,.13), --shadow-xl: 0 24px 64px rgba(100,90,120,.16). Add extended palette tokens: --purple-50: #f5f3f9, --purple-100: #ece7f2, --purple-200: #d8cfe8, --purple-300: #bfb0d3, --purple-400: #a08fbc, --purple-500: #8470a6, --purple-600: #6f5d92, --purple-700: #5d4d7c, --purple-800: #4c3e66, --purple-900: #3c3053. Add green palette: --green-50: #f0f7f4, --green-100: #dceee7, --green-200: #b8ddd0, --green-500: #4a9e82, --green-600: #3d8a6f. Add rose palette: --rose-50: #fdf2f4, --rose-100: #faddde, --rose-500: #c4697b, --rose-600: #a8576a. Add typography scale: --text-xs: 10px, --text-sm: 11px, --text-base: 13px, --text-lg: 15px, --text-xl: 18px. Add transition utilities: --transition-fast: 0.14s ease-out, --transition-base: 0.2s ease-out, --transition-slow: 0.3s ease-out.

Step 2 — Add new @keyframes to index.css: @keyframes fadeInUp { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(12px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }. @keyframes ripple { 0% { transform:scale(0); opacity:0.6; } 100% { transform:scale(2.8); opacity:0; } }. @keyframes shimmer { 0% { background-position:-400px 0; } 100% { background-position:400px 0; } }. @keyframes recordingPulse { 0%,100% { transform:scale(1); box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(187,140,155,.5), 0 0 0 0 rgba(187,140,155,.3); } 50% { transform:scale(1.04); box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(187,140,155,.2), 0 0 0 22px rgba(187,140,155,.08); } }. @keyframes statusDot { 0%,100% { opacity:1; } 50% { opacity:0.4; } }.

Step 3 — Add a .dark class variable override block in index.css after :root: .dark { --background: #1a1723; --foreground: #ede9f4; --card: #221e2c; --card-foreground: #ede9f4; --muted: #2c2739; --muted-foreground: #9b94aa; --border: #342f43; --primary: #9b8ec4; --primary-foreground: #1a1723; --accent: #2f2a3d; --ring: #7d6fab; }
